behaviour: A white, crumbly cheese kept in brine, made from the milk of sheep, cow or goat, and salty and a little tangy. It is crumbled into pastry fillings, salads and meze, and it softens in the heat without melting into strings. Soaking it in water draws out some of the salt.

contains.basis: It is a cheese made from milk.
Many white cheeses are set with animal rennet.
